name: Gmina Witkowo (Poland)
description: Light blue field charged at the centre with a yellow radiant eye of providence from the gmina arms below the name WITKOWO in black.
history: Polish gmina flags are established by resolution of the gmina council under the Act on Badges and Uniforms, normally after an opinion of the Heraldic Commission; the flag takes the colours of the arms.

features.role: radiant eye of providence from the gmina arms
